prompt: Implement per-customer promotion usage limits in the discount engine. Limits are keyed by customer and stable rule ID and persist in a shared UsageStore across engine instances. A limit of zero is unlimited. Quotes observe existing usage without recording it; redemptions record only rules that actually apply a positive discount. Exhausted rules must not block other rules in their exclusive group. Preserve priority, stacking, minimum-subtotal and rounding behavior. Run `./scripts/javatest.sh` offline. Do not edit, delete, or skip protected tests.
